when.quote: Procedure for opening personal savings accounts.

info.about: Any 2 of date of birth, email, phone number, address, checked against records
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you give me two of these: your date of birth, email, phone number or address on file?

info.about: How much the customer will put into savings and keep there; it decides which accounts' opening deposit and ongoing minimum balance they can meet
info.ask: How much do you plan to deposit into the savings account, and will you keep that full amount there?

info.about: Whether the customer is willing to hold a Rho-Bank credit card for an APY bonus. If they decline, recommend without card bonuses and do not push a card
The customer's checking and savings accounts: class, status, balance, date_opened
Age from the date of birth on file. It rules out age-restricted checking accounts (Dark Green 17 to 26, Gold Years 62 and over)
Whether to transfer the opening deposit from checking now, or have the customer fund it themselves within 30 days
info.ask: Would you like me to transfer the opening deposit from your checking account now, or will you fund the account yourself?

steps.do: Look up the customer by the name or email they give
steps.quote: To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools, and ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address.

steps.do: Confirm that 2 of DOB, email, phone and address match the records. Share no account information before this
steps.quote: Knowing full name or userID is not enough to verify.

steps.do: Get the current time for the verification log and for tenure and fee checks
steps.quote: If you need the current time, always use the get_current_time() tool.

steps.do: Log the verification record
steps.quote: After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records.

steps.do: Unlock the account lookup tool
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Retrieve all the customer's bank accounts
steps.quote: Checking eligibility requirements for opening new accounts (existing account status, balances, account tenure, number of accounts)

steps.do: If the customer also wants to close their existing checking account, explain that savings must be opened first: savings needs an existing active checking account held for at least 14 days, and a newly opened checking account will not meet that tenure. Only then move on to opening the new checking account and closing the old one
steps.if: the customer also wants to close their only qualifying checking account or asks to do that first
steps.quote: Confirm an active checking account exists and meets the 14-day tenure requirement.

steps.do: Check the following. There is an active checking account opened at least 14 days ago. The customer holds fewer than 5 personal savings accounts. No account is in collections or has a negative balance
steps.quote: Do not proceed if any item above is not met.

steps.do: Ask how much will be deposited and whether it stays untouched. Ask about willingness to hold a credit card only if needed; if the customer declines, never push one
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Compute the best checking and savings pairing for the deposit. Drop savings accounts whose opening deposit or ongoing minimum the customer cannot meet. Drop checking accounts the customer is ineligible for by age or balance. Total APY = savings base or tier APY plus the single highest qualifying linked-checking boost. Give one recommendation, not a list. For deposits under $10,000 with no credit card, the best pairing is Evergreen Account (checking) + Green Account (savings): 4.0% + 0.55% = 4.55%
steps.quote: 3. Evergreen Account (checking) + Green Account (savings)

steps.do: Unlock the account opening tool
steps.quote: Use the open_bank_account_4821 tool with account_type set to 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.

steps.do: Open the chosen savings account

arguments.account_class: the confirmed savings class, full official name (e.g. 'Green Account')

steps.quote: Capture the exact account_class string. It must be the full official name ending with “Account” (for example, “Silver Plus Account”, “Gold Account”).

steps.do: Ask whether to transfer the opening deposit from checking now
steps.quote: Ask the customer if they want you to transfer the opening deposit from their checking account now.

steps.do: Unlock transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291, then transfer the opening deposit from checking to the new savings account

arguments.amount: the opening deposit confirmed with the customer

steps.if: customer says yes and the checking account has the funds
steps.quote: If yes: use transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to transfer the required amount from the customer’s checking account to the newly opened savings account.

steps.do: Tell the customer they have 30 days to fund the account or it will be closed
steps.quote: If no: inform the customer they have 30 days to fund the account (via internal transfer or external deposit) or the account will be closed.

steps.do: Give the new account details and the funding status or deadline
steps.quote: Provide the new account details and confirm the funding status or the funding deadline.

rules.rule: Savings requires an active Rho-Bank checking account held at least 14 days; a checking account opened today does not qualify
rules.quote: Confirm an active checking account exists and meets the 14-day tenure requirement.

rules.rule: The customer must hold fewer than 5 personal savings accounts
rules.quote: Customer currently holds fewer than 5 personal savings accounts.

rules.rule: No accounts in collections and no negative balances
rules.quote: Customer has no accounts in collections and no negative balances.

rules.rule: If tenure is under 14 days, tell the customer when they become eligible
rules.quote: Insufficient checking tenure: If the checking account has been open fewer than 14 days, advise the customer when they will become eligible.

rules.rule: Only the listed pairings earn a linked-checking boost
rules.quote: Note: Only these specific pairings qualify for the linked checking account APY boost.

rules.rule: Checking boosts do not stack; only the highest applies
rules.quote: Checking account APY boosts do NOT stack with each other.

rules.rule: Green Account (savings) base APY 4.0%
rules.quote: The APY reflects the effect of compounding and is set at 4.0%.

rules.rule: Green Account (savings) needs $100 to open
rules.quote: Fund the account with at least $100.

rules.rule: Green Account (savings) needs a $500 ongoing balance
rules.quote: Keep your balance at or above $500.

rules.rule: Evergreen checking gives +0.55% on a linked Green Account (savings)
rules.quote: Link a Green Account (savings): +0.55% APY boost

rules.rule: Gold Account needs a $10,000 ongoing balance, so it is excluded for smaller deposits
rules.quote: Ongoing minimum balance: $10,000

rules.rule: Gold Plus needs $10,000 to open
rules.quote: Fund the account with at least $10,000 at opening.

rules.rule: Platinum needs $25,000 to open
rules.quote: Fund at least $25,000 at account opening.

rules.rule: Platinum Plus needs $50,000 to open
rules.quote: Initial deposit to open: $50,000

rules.rule: Diamond Elite needs $100,000 to open
rules.quote: Minimum initial deposit: $100,000.

rules.rule: Silver Plus below $15,000 earns Tier 1 3.0%; with the Blue boost of +0.35% that totals 3.35%, below 4.55%
rules.quote: Tier 1 APY: 3.0% for balances below the Tier 2 threshold.

rules.rule: Blue checking boost on Silver Plus is +0.35%
rules.quote: When linked to a Silver Plus Savings Account: +0.35% APY boost

rules.rule: Silver below $10,000 earns 2.5%; the best boost an under-62 customer can get is Green checking's +0.25%
rules.quote: If it is below that amount, the applicable APY for that day is 2.5%.

rules.rule: Bronze earns 2.0%; the best usable boost is Green Fee-Free's +0.4%
rules.quote: You earn interest at an APY of 2.0% on your balance.

rules.rule: Green Fee-Free gives +0.4% on linked Bronze
rules.quote: Link a Bronze Savings Account to receive a 0.4% APY boost on that savings balance.

rules.rule: Gold Years checking requires age 62 or older
rules.quote: You must be at least 62 years old to qualify.

rules.rule: Dark Green checking is limited to ages 17 to 26
rules.quote: You can maintain the account through 26.

rules.rule: Bluest checking needs $75,000 to open
rules.quote: Deposit at least $75,000 to open your account.

rules.rule: Credit card APY bonuses would stack with the checking boost, but only offer one if the customer wants a card
rules.quote: The boost is additive to your savings account's base APY and any credit card APY bonuses you may already have.

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged, the highest-APY eligible savings account is open, and its funding is transferred or the 30-day deadline has been stated

when.quote: To open a personal checking account, ensure all of the following are true:

info.about: The checking account chosen, normally the one paired with the new savings account for the boost
info.ask: Shall I open the recommended checking account for you?

steps.do: Confirm the customer is verified and at least 18. Count personal checking accounts: the customer may not exceed 4. Confirm no checking account was closed for cause in the past 6 months
steps.quote: 3. The customer does not exceed 4 personal checking accounts.

steps.do: Confirm the checking account_class by its full official name (e.g. 'Evergreen Account'). Mention its fee: $6.00 monthly, waived with a $500 minimum daily balance
steps.quote: Personal checking account_class options must use the full official name ending with 'Account' (e.g., 'Blue Account', 'Green Account (checking)').

steps.do: Open the checking account
steps.quote: 4. Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account.

rules.rule: Customer must be at least 18
rules.quote: 2. The customer is at least 18 years old.

rules.rule: No checking account closed for cause in the past 6 months
rules.quote: 4. The customer has no checking accounts closed for cause in the past 6 months.

rules.rule: Evergreen monthly fee is waived only with a $500 minimum daily balance
rules.quote: The monthly maintenance fee is waived when your minimum daily balance is at least $500

jobs.done_when: The new checking account that pairs with the savings account is open and confirmed to the customer

when.quote: Verify all of the following before closing:

info.about: The old checking account the customer wants closed, identified from records

steps.do: From the account records, confirm status is OPEN. Find the tier and date_opened, then compute whether an early closure fee applies using get_current_time. Light Blue is entry tier: $15 if closed within 30 days, 0-day notice. Balance must be $0, or at least the fee if a fee applies
steps.quote: If an early closure fee applies, the account balance must be at least the fee amount; otherwise, account balance (current_holdings) must be $0.

steps.do: Unlock and call get_bank_account_transactions_9173 on the account and confirm no transaction has status 'pending'
steps.quote: Agents can retrieve the transaction history for a customer's bank account (checking or savings) using the get_bank_account_transactions_9173 tool.

steps.do: Unlock the close tool
steps.quote: 3. Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

steps.do: Close the old checking account
steps.quote: 3. Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

steps.do: Confirm that the new savings and checking accounts are open, the old checking account is closed, and state the total APY
steps.quote: Provide the new account details and confirm the funding status or the funding deadline.

rules.rule: Account status must be OPEN
rules.quote: Account status is OPEN

rules.rule: No pending transactions
rules.quote: No pending transactions for this account

rules.rule: Entry tier includes Light Blue
rules.quote: ENTRY TIER (Light Blue Account, Light Green Account, Green Fee-Free Account)

rules.rule: Entry-tier early closure fee is $15 within 30 days of opening
rules.quote: Early closure fee: $15 if closed within 30 days

rules.rule: Never close the only qualifying checking account before the savings account is opened
rules.quote: Customer has at least one active Rho-Bank checking account.

jobs.done_when: The old checking account is closed and the customer has confirmation of all three changes
